naturalTree: Create a single complete stylized palm tree as a transparent-background game environment illustration, isolated with its entire trunk and crown visible, no floor or cast shadow. The visual feeling must be relaxed, soft, heavy and drooping, never a starburst of rigid spears. Keep natural pointed leaflet ends but curve them downward and let adjacent blades overlap into calm larger masses. Use about 10 to 14 visible major fronds in a loose umbrella crown, mature outer leaves drooping, a few younger leaves rising softly in the center, no rigid vertical spike. Clearly deform the proportions for a charming fantasy MMORPG: slightly shorter trunk and fuller crown, simple broad readable shapes. Hand-painted large color planes and soft matte gradients, muted gray-olive mid green, cool deep green undersides, pale desaturated sage highlights. Restrained low-to-moderate saturation, no lime, no neon yellow, no glossy wax or hard bright bevel on every leaflet, no fine vein drawing or photo grain. Slender trunk in warm gray-beige with quiet shallow ring scars, no wood-plank appearance. Three-quarter elevated game camera angle. No pot, fruit, characters, objects, ground, background, text, labels or watermark. This is an art proposal of a whole tree, not a seamless texture.
